source_authority: Federal Aviation Administration Civil Aviation Registry

source_semantics.hard_negative_rule: same exact FAA manufacturer/model/series code and distinct manufacturer serial numbers

privacy_boundary: The releasable archive may contain owner/address fields. They are never retained, logged, emitted, hashed into evidence, or uploaded. Only the explicit non-PII identity projection is processed into reviewer material.
public_ci_boundary: The source archive is transient runner input only. No raw archive, raw MASTER row, owner/address field, or full source payload may be printed or uploaded. Artifacts may contain only filtered serial/maker/model reviewer material and cryptographic digests.
